- Choose-Task startup: read progress, current_tasks.md, and current_tasks_done.md.

- Next: read task file, determine whether it is in TO BE VERIFIED/NOW EXECUTE state, then either create/verify plan or execute it.

- Read task 33/02: Add Generic Batched Kube API Operations. It is not_started/passes=false and has no existing plan marker.
- Per Ralph instructions this is a planning-only turn: create a separate plan file, add plan path to task, end plan with NOW EXECUTE, then quit immediately.
- Read existing kubeapi client/config/startup/test shape. Existing typed client is internal/kubeapi/client.go with generic typedResource methods for create/update/apply/status/delete/watch; no finalizer patch or batch API exists yet.
- Read improve-code-boundaries smell files. Main boundary risk for this task is bloating client.go and duplicating six batch methods for two resources without a shared typedResource batch boundary.
- Next: write .ralph/tasks/33-story-reconcile-write-efficiency/02-task-add-batched-kubeapi-patch-and-put_plans/01-batched-kubeapi-operations-plan.md and update task <plan> to NOW EXECUTE.

- Created plan .ralph/tasks/33-story-reconcile-write-efficiency/02-task-add-batched-kubeapi-patch-and-put_plans/01-batched-kubeapi-operations-plan.md.
- Updated task file with a <plan> block pointing at the new plan and NOW EXECUTE.
- The plan covers config defaults/validation, generic ExecuteBatch, typed batch request structs and methods, finalizer JSON Patch, fake kube-api request-count tests, 10,000+ resource coverage, race test, make gates, and final boundary review.
- Per instructions, this planning turn must quit immediately after verifying the plan marker.

- Execution turn startup: read prior progress, current task, task file, and execution plan.
- Task marker is NOW EXECUTE, so proceed with TDD execution instead of redesign.
- Existing worktree has Ralph bookkeeping/planning files already modified/untracked; do not revert them.
- Next: read improve-code-boundaries smell files, inspect config/kubeapi code, then start RED config tests.

- Completed first TDD cycle for config kubeAPI defaults/explicit values.
- RED: go test ./internal/config -run 'TestLoadKubeAPIConfig' failed because Config.KubeAPI was undefined.
- GREEN: added config.KubeAPIConfig, raw kubeAPI yaml parsing/defaulting/negative validation, and compose kubeAPI values.
- Focused test now passes: go test ./internal/config -run 'TestLoadKubeAPIConfig' -count=1.
- Next: add negative validation/compose-file behavior coverage, then move to kubeapi ExecuteBatch worker default test.

- Completed ExecuteBatch default-worker TDD cycle.
- RED: TestExecuteBatchDefaultsToOneWorker failed because BatchKey/BatchConfig/BatchOperation/ExecuteBatch did not exist.
- GREEN: added internal/kubeapi/batch.go with exported batch API types, deterministic key ordering, worker pool, rate limiter, in-flight semaphore, BatchItemError/BatchError, and zap info/debug logs.
- Focused test now passes: go test ./internal/kubeapi -run TestExecuteBatchDefaultsToOneWorker -count=1.
- Next: add configured worker count 20 and 10,000+ result-accounting tests, then rate/in-flight/error/cancellation behavior.

- Added ExecuteBatch tests for configured 20-worker concurrency and 10,000 item result accounting.
- Focused test passes: go test ./internal/kubeapi -run 'TestExecuteBatch(UsesConfiguredWorkerCount|Handles10000Items)' -count=1.
- Current executor already satisfies these via deterministic scheduling, worker pool, high-rate config in the large test, and complete result maps.
- Next: add max in-flight, max requests per second, per-item error/no-retry, and cancellation tests.

- Added fake kube-api server group batch method coverage for create, update, apply, status PUT, delete, and finalizer JSON Patch.
- RED: TestGroupBatchMethodsUseExpectedKubeAPIRequests failed on missing Options.BatchConfig, request structs, and batch methods.
- GREEN: added Options.BatchConfig, stored batchConfig on typedResource, added batch_methods.go with public group/network-cloud request structs and batch methods, plus typedResource.patchFinalizers JSON Patch.
- Focused group fake-server test now passes.
- Next: add equivalent NetworkCloud fake-server test and startup config wiring.

- Added NetworkCloud fake-server batch method coverage; focused group+network-cloud fake-server tests pass.
- Wired options.Config.KubeAPI into kubeapi.Options.BatchConfig in startup.NewManager.
- Added kubeAPI fields to the startup loaded-config debug log.
- A broad direct go test ./internal/config ./internal/kubeapi ./internal/startup -count=1 failed because envtest-based tests require KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS when not run through make; keep using focused non-envtest runs until final make gates set envtest.
- Next: run focused non-envtest batch/config/startup tests, add any missing validation coverage, then run make check/test/coverage.

- Added kubeAPI negative validation tests and compose config runtime value test; focused config tests pass.
- Focused batch tests pass: go test ./internal/kubeapi -run 'TestExecuteBatch|Test(Group|NetworkCloud)BatchMethodsUseExpectedKubeAPIRequests' -count=1.
- Required 10,000 item race test passes: go test -race ./internal/kubeapi -run 'TestExecuteBatchHandles10000Items' -count=1.
- Next: run make check, make test, make test-coverage; fix any compile/test/coverage failures.

- make check passed after fixing staticcheck S1016 in parseKubeAPIConfig.
- make test passed.
- make test-coverage passed: total coverage 84.6%, internal/kubeapi coverage 80.7%.
- Final boundary review found shared batch mechanics confined to internal/kubeapi/batch.go, typed batch glue in batch_methods.go, config defaulting/validation in internal/config, and startup passing reduced validated values only.
- Updated task file to status completed, passes=true, checked acceptance criteria, and recorded verification evidence.
- Next: run .ralph/task_switch.sh, git add all files, commit with required task finished message, then git push.
